Prompt 

**CHARACTER REFERENCE (locked, identical in both blocks)**
Desi — South Asian woman, mid-20s, warm brown skin, expressive dark brown eyes, defined brows, full lips, small bindi centered on her forehead, long dark wavy hair. Gold jhumka earrings and thin gold necklace persist unchanged as her fixed visual anchor across every look and both blocks — never removed, never swapped, never obscured.

**VOICE PROFILE — DESI (Fashion Reel Register)**
A fourth, distinct register from her internal-monologue (Waking World), solo-GRWM, and podcast voices — built for a short, punchy, trend-aware piece to camera.
Register: Bright, warm mid-range, effortless confidence — not performative-influencer loud, but polished and camera-aware in a way her other registers deliberately aren't.
Pacing: The single line is delivered crisp and unhurried despite the short runtime — a clean, confident statement, not rushed to fit the beat.
Tone: Playful warmth, a genuine natural smile audible in the voice itself, zero hesitation or filler.
Delivery: Direct eye contact into the lens for the full line, chin level, no looking away mid-sentence.

**MANNERISMS (throughout the piece, both blocks)**
Movement quality shifts from her other registers — here she is camera-aware and enjoys it, moving with a model's ease: deliberate confident turns, weight shifts that favor the camera, a natural playful energy in transitions (a small hair-tuck, a spin that trails into the next look, a genuine laugh caught mid-transition on at least one look). Default expression across looks is soft, easy confidence — not blank or posed-stiff. Her gold jewelry catches light naturally as she moves; this should read as a small recurring visual beat, not incidental.

**ENVIRONMENT REFERENCE (locked, identical in both blocks)**
A bright, minimalist luxury apartment. Matte white walls with a soft warm undertone, wide-plank light oak flooring, exposed warm-toned wooden ceiling beams overhead. Floor-to-ceiling windows along one wall flood the space with soft golden daylight, filtered through sheer ivory linen curtains diffusing the light into a warm, even glow. A freestanding full-length mirror in a slim brass frame stands near the window. A low-profile cream boucle armchair sits in one corner with a folded cream throw draped over the arm. A round marble side table holds a small vase of dried pampas grass and a glass of iced coffee beading with condensation. A neatly made bed with white linen bedding is visible in soft-focus background on some angles. Palette: warm cream, soft beige, blonde wood tones, directional golden-hour-style shadows moving across the floor throughout.

**BASE GARMENT (constant across both blocks):** Dusty-rose lightweight cotton-voile sundress. Adjustable spaghetti straps, gently gathered waist with a self-tie fabric sash, flowing A-line skirt to mid-calf, small row of covered fabric buttons down the front bodice placket.

---

## BLOCK 1 (0:00–0:10)

**Opening — 0:00–0:02:**
Smooth dolly arc — a semicircular arc moving roughly 30–40 degrees around Desi from a 3/4 angle toward a front-facing angle as she holds the sundress on a hanger. Arc settles into a locked front angle exactly as she finishes speaking. She looks directly into the camera, smiles naturally, and clearly says: **"One dress, ten ways to style."** On-screen text, matching: **"1 Dress 🤍 10 Ways to Style."** Speech accurate, natural, precisely lip-synced.

**Montage, Looks 1–5 — 0:02–0:10:**
Whip pans, snap cuts, match cuts, ~1.6s per look.

1. **Casual Chic** — Dress worn loose, sash untied and hanging at the sides, tortoiseshell round sunglasses pushed onto her head, woven raffia tote over one shoulder, flat woven-leather sandals.
2. **Front Knot** — Hem gathered and knotted at the front just above the waist, sitting mid-thigh, worn open over dark-wash straight-leg denim shorts, sash tied loosely off to one side.
3. **Off-Shoulder Elegant** — Both straps pulled down and tucked to sit low across the upper arms, sash cinched neatly at the natural waist, hair swept over one shoulder, low tan leather block-heel sandals.
4. **Belted Waist** — Dress worn full-length as designed, slim woven gold-tone belt cinched over the sash for structure, tan wedge espadrilles.
5. **Denim Layer** — Dress worn under an oversized light-wash denim jacket, sleeves rolled to the elbow, dress hem visible below the jacket, white canvas sneakers.

Block ends held on Look 5's final pose: Desi standing near the window in the denim jacket, mid-turn toward camera, natural smile settling into place, gold earrings catching the window light, camera static on the locked front angle from the opening arc.

**NEGATIVES / CONSTRAINTS — BLOCK 1**
All characters depicted are adults; only Desi appears. No duplicate Desi in any frame. No face morphing or identity drift across Looks 1–5 — same face, same bindi placement, same gold jhumka earrings and necklace visible and unchanged throughout, including through the opening dolly arc. No wardrobe discontinuity within a look. No extra fingers, fused hands, or distorted anatomy during spins, whip pans, or the arc. Realistic fabric physics on the dress, sash, jacket, and every accessory — natural drape and weight, no clipping, no teleporting garments between cuts. No recognizable brand logos on any garment, bag, sunglasses, footwear, or accessory. The opening dolly arc must read as smooth, continuous, mechanically stable — no jitter, no speed-ramping, no snap mid-arc. Opening spoken line must be accurately lip-synced. No AI generation artifacts, no warped transitions, no motion blur obscuring garment or environment detail.

---

## BLOCK 2 (0:10–0:20)

**Continuity note:** Opens on the exact final frame of Block 1 — Desi in the denim-jacket Look 5, mid-turn, near the window, camera on the same locked front angle, same lighting and shadow position. No reset, no re-establishing shot.

**Montage, Looks 6–10 — 0:00–0:07 (of this block):**
Whip pans, snap cuts, match cuts continue at the same ~1.4s per look pace, picking up directly from Look 5's held pose.

6. **Beach Day** — Dress worn loose and untied, wide-brim natural straw hat, tan canvas espadrille wedges, holding the iced coffee glass from the side table.
7. **Tokyo Prep / Academia-Inspired** — Dress layered under a cream tailored wool-blend blazer, buttoned closed, a thin black ribbon tied in a small bow at the collar, dress hem falling just below the blazer at knee-length, white knee-high socks pulled up neatly, brown leather penny loafers, hair in two neat low braids tied with small ribbons. Fully covered, adult, polished editorial styling — no leg or thigh emphasis, no suggestive posing.
8. **Elegant Date Night** — Dress worn full-length, sash tied neatly at the waist, delicate gold chain clutch, strappy low block heels, hair down and loosely waved, soft dewy natural makeup.
9. **Athleisure Layer** — Dress worn over black bike shorts (hem just visible below the dress), cropped light-wash denim vest layered over the bodice, white leather sneakers, hair in a high sporty ponytail.
10. **Monochrome Minimal (final look)** — Dress worn exactly as designed, no outer layers, sash tied simply, hair down and natural, minimal accessories beyond her signature gold jewelry, simple flat sandals.

**Ending — 0:07–0:10 (of this block):**
A second dolly arc — a smooth 180-degree arcing move around Desi in Look 10, while Looks 1–9 rapidly fan out and orbit around her in a circular reveal, materializing in sync with the arc's motion rather than snapping in. Arc lands on a final locked front angle. On-screen text: **"10 Looks. 1 Dress. 🤍 Which one's your favorite?"**

No dialogue in this block — the only spoken line in the piece is the opening line in Block 1.

**NEGATIVES / CONSTRAINTS — BLOCK 2**
Continuity from Block 1 is mandatory: Desi's identity, wardrobe state, pose, and the environment/lighting must match Block 1's final frame exactly at 0:00 of this block — no discontinuity, no re-established shot, no wardrobe reset. All characters depicted are adults; only Desi appears. No duplicate Desi in any frame. No face morphing or identity drift across Looks 6–10 or through the closing arc — same face, same bindi placement, same gold jhumka earrings and necklace visible and unchanged throughout. Look 7 (Tokyo Prep/Academia-Inspired) must read as fully adult and editorial: knee socks pulled up properly, blazer buttoned, dress hem unchanged at knee-length, no suggestive posing or camera angles emphasizing legs/thighs — same tasteful tone as every other look. No wardrobe discontinuity within a look. No extra fingers, fused hands, or distorted anatomy. Realistic fabric physics throughout — no clipping, no teleporting garments. No recognizable brand logos anywhere. The closing dolly arc must read as smooth, continuous, mechanically stable — no jitter, no snap mid-arc. The fanned-out reveal looks must materialize in sync with the arc's motion, not pop in or overlap incorrectly — no duplicated or malformed dress silhouettes among the surrounding looks. No AI generation artifacts, no warped transitions, no motion blur obscuring detail.

---

**AUDIO (spans both blocks):** Block 1 carries the spoken opening line, then transition/whoosh sound design synced to whip pans and the opening arc. Block 2 continues the same transition sound design through Looks 6–10 and the closing arc, no dialogue. Upbeat trending-style instrumental music bed under the full montage across both blocks (generic, non-copyrighted), continuous and unbroken across the block cut.

She listens to music through white wired earphones, carries a small Canon compact camera, wears Lacoste throughout three changing fashion looks, and ends dancing with a friend. Hard cuts only. [LEAD]
Generate an original beautiful sweet slim woman in her early 20s. Delicate oval face, large dark-brown eyes, long straight black hair, soft winged eyeliner, long lashes, glossy peach-nude lips, warm light skin, slim athletic figure, elegant hands, long nude manicured nails, tiny silver earrings. Naturally beautiful, sweet expression, subtle smile becoming genuine laughter. No glasses. She never speaks.

Appears only from 22 seconds. Young Portuguese woman, early 20s, long chestnut hair, soft round face, loose pale-blue shirt, cream trousers and white sneakers. No earphones.

LOOK A 0–7s:
Lacoste crimson zip track jacket, white fitted top, black trousers, white sneakers, small black shoulder bag, Canon compact camera.

0–2.5s

11.2–13s

13–15s
35mm tram interior. She sits beside window, earphones visible, watching Lisbon pass.

15–17s
50mm reflection in tram glass. Her eyes meet camera reflection and she smiles.

17–19.2s
Hard cut to ocean cliff. LOOK C. She walks toward railing, wind moving black jacket.

19.2–21s
24mm wide. She reaches cliff edge and looks toward Atlantic waves.

21–22.4s
85mm portrait. Hair moves across her cheek. She laughs softly.

22.4–24.5s
Friend enters at harbor. Lead turns and immediately smiles.

24.5–26.5s
35mm tracking. Both walk beside fishing boats, comparing the Canon camera photos and laughing.

26.5–28s
Low-angle shot. They run a few steps toward sunset plaza.

28–30s
Wide-to-medium dance. Both casually dance on stone plaza overlooking ocean.
At 28.4s giant mustard-yellow condensed type:
【PORTUGAL】
At 29.1s it changes to:
【LIVE A LITTLE】

Hard cut to black.

[CAMERA]
35mm movement, 50mm portraits, 85mm details, 24mm landscapes. Handheld walking energy, gentle lateral tracking and one natural spin. No drone orbit, no crash zooms.

[PHYSICS]
Real hair weight, natural jacket wrinkles, realistic earphone cable movement, authentic ocean wind, natural pedestrian motion, believable camera weight and reflections.

[AUDIO]
Tram bell, footsteps, camera shutter, distant café ambience, ocean wind, waves, harbor ropes, natural laughter. No dialogue or voiceover. Only specified English title cards.

[CONSISTENCY]
One original lead throughout. Friend only after 22s. White wired earphones always visible. Lacoste fashion only. Canon compact camera consistent. Photoreal live action.

We’ve all seen how messy the balance is between staying on-distribution and actually maximizing reward. 

Most people either throw in awkward penalties or just use diffusion models and live with painful sampling latencies.

They treat behavioral constraints and value optimization as motion fields in action space, blend them, and bake the whole thing into a one step generator. 

You get the expressiveness of a generative model without having to wait on multi step denoising at test time, just a single forward pass.

They tested it on 73 tasks across D4RL and OGBench and took the top average rank against some serious diffusion and flow baselines. 

Definitely worth reading if you care about fast continuous control: https://t.co/FWtPTmNFiK
